title.zh: CLARITY Act’s ‘final’ deal is already breaking down before tomorrow’s Senate vote
title.en: CLARITY Act’s ‘final’ deal is already breaking down before tomorrow’s Senate vote

current_state.zh: Senate Republicans released a final CLARITY Act draft incorporating 126 Democratic-requested changes, but banks, Democrats, state attorneys general, and developer advocates still oppose key provisions ahead of Tuesday's 60-vote cloture test.
current_state.en: Senate Republicans released a final CLARITY Act draft incorporating 126 Democratic-requested changes, but banks, Democrats, state attorneys general, and developer advocates still oppose key provisions ahead of Tuesday's 60-vote cloture test.
